source.label: Statistics Canada — Table 98-10-0011-01, population centres (2021 Census)
Land Information Ontario — municipal boundaries, lower and single tier (map service layer 14)

_meta.method: Each 2021 population centre in Ontario was looked up by name in the CGNDB (official names of populated places: unincorporated places, cities, towns, villages, hamlets). Names held by populated places in more than one county were skipped as ambiguous. The CGNDB point was placed in a municipality with the LIO boundary layer, and a centre is kept only if it falls in one of the areas and its population is no larger than its municipality's.
